subject: GCP co-sell sprint deconflict + joint pipeline tidy-up
body:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samirshah@google.com>, Priya Bhat <priya.bhat@acmehealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GCP co-sell sprint deconflict + joint pipeline tidy-up

Hi all —

We have our co-sell sprint starting next week and I want to align on two quick items before the kickoff:

1) Opportunity overlaps & owner clarity — Priya / Acme has two marketplace-listed trials that look like they could be double-counted in our pipeline and Samir flagged overlap with a GCP field motion.
2) Playbook actions for the sprint — what GCP PMs will own (intro emails, joint demo slots, PRM approvals) vs. what Redwood will own (pricing doc, security artifacts, customer-facing SOW draft).

Attached are a proposed risk register and the latest joint pipeline snapshot. Please skim — I highlighted the top 6 at-risk opps.

Would like a short alignment call Tues 10–10:30am PT if that works for the GCP team; otherwise we can do an async thread. Action items I want by EOD Mon:
- Samir: confirm which accounts GCP intends to /co-sell/ with this sprint and any field leads we should loop in.
- Priya: confirm primary contact and timeline for buying committee at Acme Health.
- Karthik & Vanessa: confirm Redwood playbook owners for demo, pricing, and SOC2 evidence.

Thanks — trying to keep this light but tight as we enter the sprint.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Partner Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: gcp_co-sell_sprint_risk_register.xlsx (spreadsheet), joint_pipeline_snapshot_20270418.pdf (PDF)

-------------------------

From: Samir Shah <samirshah@google.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priya Bhat <priya.bhat@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell sprint deconflict + joint pipeline tidy-up

Thanks Lauren — quick responses inline.

- Overlaps: GCP intends to run a field outreach on two of the names Priya shared, but Samir clarified those are for a separate sales segment (cloud cost mgmt) that will not block Redwood’s inference listing motion. I attached a short note on segmentation.
- GCP PM owners: I’ll loop Amy Chen (GCP PM) into the kickoff — she owns marketplace enablement for Healthcare. Amy will take the intro emails and the initial joint demo scheduling.

We can do Tue 10am PT. I’ll invite Amy and the regional field rep.

Samir Shah
Partner Manager, Google Cloud

> Attachment: gcp_field_segmentation_note.txt

-------------------------

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Samir Shah <samirshah@google.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell sprint deconflict + joint pipeline tidy-up

Great — appreciate Samir confirming segmentation. A couple clarifications from our side:

- Demo playbook: Vanessa will run the joint demo (she has a slot Tue 11am PT but can move). We will provide a 20-min product demo + 10-min GCP value-add.
- Pricing doc: Ben will own final pricing sheet for Acme, but I’ll draft the initial version. Target to share by Tue EOD.
- Security artifacts: SOC2 + data flow diagram — we have a validated pack but need to check retention limits per Acme’s data policy. Vanessa, can you confirm retention note?

I’ll create a shared folder with the two attachments and the pricing draft.

Karthik
Sr. Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

-------------------------

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Samir Shah <samirshah@google.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priya Bhat <priya.bhat@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:39:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell sprint deconflict + joint pipeline tidy-up

Retention confirmed: Acme requires 30-day token retention max for PII-adjacent logs. Our SOC2 pack covers that but I’ll add a short note in the security packet to make it explicit.

Vanessa — I can take Tue 10–10:30 for the alignment call but prefer Tue 11 for the demo (fits my calendar). If GCP needs the demo earlier we can compress to 20 minutes.

I also updated the risk register: moved two opps to "needs qualification" (see attached).

— Vanessa Ortiz
Partner GTM | Redwood Inference

> Attachment: updated_risk_register_markups.xlsx

-------------------------

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samirshah@google.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priya Bhat <priya.bhat@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell sprint deconflict + joint pipeline tidy-up

Thanks everyone — summary and next steps: 

1) Alignment call scheduled: Tue 10:00–10:30 PT (Samir, Amy, Vanessa, Karthik, Lauren). I’ll send calendar invite with agenda.
2) Demo: Tue 11:00–11:30 PT (Vanessa leads demo; Amy will add 10 mins on GCP value props).
3) Deliverables: Ben to circulate draft pricing by Tue EOD; Vanessa will publish an explicit 30-day retention note in the security packet; Karthik to upload the pricing draft + folder link.
4) Pipeline housekeeping: I’ll merge GCP segmentation note into the joint snapshot and mark the two segmented opps as GCP-field-owned.

If Priya (Acme) can confirm the buying committee contact before Tue kickoff that will make the sprint run smoother.

Appreciate the quick turnaround on this — I’ll follow up with calendar invites and the drive link.

Best,
Lauren

---
Thread end.
